infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LMPC Inspector requires camera access to capture packaging labels and reference scaling cards.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LMPC Inspector attaches precise GPS coordinates to each inspection for statutory compliance records.
